summary: Strict checklist-based contemplation evaluation and PR-ready Question closure for Epic #257

entries.migration_impact: Contemplation now evaluates checklist-style `Answer signal` criteria against cited answer evidence and reports when a Question is ready to close via a PR artifact instead of relying on done/complete heuristics. Question authors should use checklist-style `Answer signal` items in the issue template.
entries.agent_notes: Questions are only PR-close-ready when every checklist item is backed by explicit citations or links in the effective answer history. Revised answers can invalidate prior evidence. This slice also dogfoods the engine on Question #326 and keeps the blocking-question resumption path intact.
